prepared_by: independent test writer, round 2 (hand-verified with git)
notes: Round-2 held-out questions, written by hand with read-only git (git show/log/diff -M/tag --contains) AFTER round-1 (E2) results were seen; disjoint from every round-1 question in evals/repo_questions/*.json. No rw.repo output was consulted. Do not edit after any run: changes require a new evaluation retaining the originals. expected_facts holds the concrete answer (values are Python literals; `first_tag_containing` is the earliest tag matching the repo's tag_pattern whose commit has the fix commit as an ancestor; fix `state` is judged on content).

questions.question: At 2.2.0, what is Signer.default_key_derivation set to?
At 0.24, what is the value of EPOCH?
When did the EPOCH constant disappear?
questions.expected_answer: Present at 0.24 (itsdangerous.py:58); absent at 1.0.0, the first later tag (removed by 9981a90 'use full timestamps, no cutoff at 2011').

questions.question: At 2.2.0, which exceptions does Signer.unsign raise?
questions.expected_answer: BadSignature only (two sites: missing separator, line 249; signature mismatch, line 256).

questions.question: At 2.2.0, what does Signer.derive_key raise for an unknown key derivation method?
questions.expected_answer: TypeError('Unknown key derivation method') (signer.py line 213, in derive_key 182-213).

questions.question: At 2.2.0, which exception does URLSafeSerializerMixin.load_payload raise?
questions.expected_answer: BadPayload, for base64 decode failure (line 39) and zlib decompress failure (line 48).

questions.question: Is commit 41ec419 ('allow salt=None again') present at 2.2.0, and which tag first contains it?
questions.expected_answer: PRESENT: Signer.__init__ still has `if salt is not None:` (signer.py line 153) and Serializer.__init__ (serializer.py line 212); first tag containing it is 2.0.1.

questions.question: Is commit 41ec419 (allow salt=None again) present at 2.0.0?
questions.expected_answer: ABSENT: at 2.0.0 Signer.__init__ does `self.salt: bytes = want_bytes(salt)` unconditionally; the fix first ships in 2.0.1.

questions.question: Which functions or methods under src/ changed between 2.0.0 and 2.0.1?
questions.expected_answer: Modified: Serializer.__init__, Signer.__init__ (salt=None), _CompactJSON.loads, _CompactJSON.dumps, DeprecatedJSON.__getattribute__ (json -> _json); __init__.py export list edited; nothing added, removed or renamed.

questions.question: At 2.2.0, what does URLSafeSerializerMixin.load_payload depend on?
questions.expected_answer: itsdangerous.encoding.base64_decode and itsdangerous.exc.BadPayload (in-repo), zlib.decompress (external), and Serializer.load_payload via super().
